replace_model.description:
The conversation agent is set to `{model}`, which this SpaceXAI account cannot use. Assist cannot use this agent until you pick another model.

1. Choose a replacement from the models available to the account.
2. Submit the form to update the conversation agent.

The agent becomes available after that model is saved.

subscription_not_entitled.description:
The signed-in SpaceXAI account cannot use Grok this way, so conversation agents stay unavailable.

1. Check the plan in the SpaceXAI console (link below).
2. If the plan is on a different account, remove this integration and add it again with that account.
3. Reload the integration or sign in again after the account can use Grok.

Conversation agents become available once SpaceXAI accepts the account.
subscription_not_entitled.title: SpaceXAI subscription access is unavailable
